observed_result:
Every test named in the reproduction command exists: `go test -list . ./checkpoint/` lists TestPlasticChemicalIndividualSubprocessResumeMatchesUninterrupted and TestPlasticChemicalIndividualHelperProcess (both matched by the unanchored pattern TestPlasticChemicalIndividual), TestLoadIndividualAcceptsScalarPointerRuleFields, TestCheckRequiredFieldsScalarPointerKinds, TestIndividualCheckpointSubprocessResume, TestLIFIndividualCheckpointSubprocessResume, TestSubprocessResumeMatchesUninterruptedTraining, TestSaveLoadIndividualCarriesThePlasticPart and TestSaveLoadIndividualCarriesTheChemicalPart. No name was missing. Command output: 9 top-level '--- PASS' lines, 0 '--- FAIL' lines, package ok github.com/TimLai666/coimnet/checkpoint 6.872s, run under -race with -count=1. 

(1) Interrupted vs uninterrupted, with fast weights, chemistry and the optimizer at once. TestPlasticChemicalIndividualSubprocessResumeMatchesUninterrupted PASS (2.14s). The fixture (checkpoint/individual_full_resume_test.go) is a three-node continuous chain (Nodes 3, Sources [0,1,1], Targets [1,1,2], tanh, DT 1, readout node 2) with a hebbian_rate plasticity rule on edge 1 gated through receptor 0 (GateReceptor = &0, GateScale 1, DecayE/DecayP .5, PlasticMax 1, WMin .01), a one-region one-channel chemistry declaration (Tau [2], one external timeline releasing rate 1 on row 1, one hypothesized octopamine receptor on node 2) and the AdamW update of learning/trainer.go:407 (decoupled decay; DefaultOptions leaves WeightDecay 0 here, so the optimizer state actually exercised is the Adam first/second moments plus the per-parameter step counts, with LearningRate .02 and only Weights trainable). The same eight episodes of the delayed-pulse stream run twice: once straight through (plasticChemicalEpisodes = 8, line 27), and once broken after four (plasticChemicalBreak = 4, line 28) with SaveIndividual, then a real new process (exec of the test binary with -test.run=^TestPlasticChemicalIndividualHelperProcess$ and COIMNET_PLASTIC_CHEMICAL_RESUME_HELPER=1) doing LoadIndividual, learning.RestoreIndividual, a read of the sidecar cursor and the remaining four episodes. The assertion at line 77 is reflect.DeepEqual over the whole final learning.IndividualSnapshot, so Parameters, Neural, Optimizer, Plastic and Chemical all have to agree at once; lines 82-92 additionally pin that the resumed snapshot still carries a Plastic part, still carries a Chemical part, has at least one non-zero value among Eligibility/Plastic/PreTrace/PostTrace (so the fast-weight comparison is not a comparison of zeros) and reports Optimizer.Updates == 8, one update per episode across the break. 

(2) Bit-for-bit outputs after the break. Line 80 compares the last output row of episodes e = 4..7 produced by the resumed process against the same four rows of the uninterrupted run, with assertOutputsIdentical comparing math.Float64bits (line 298), not a tolerance. 

(3) Counterexample: the data cursor is part of the resume. Subtest WrongCursorReplaysAnEpisode PASS (1.07s). Writing the sidecar as next_episode = 3 (plasticChemicalBreak-1, line 97) makes the helper replay one episode, and line 106 requires the resulting snapshot NOT to equal the uninterrupted one. The snapshot type itself declares it holds no data cursor (learning/individual.go:97), so the cursor has to be the caller's sidecar. 

(4) Randomness. This fixture has no separate RNG state to save. The only stochastic-looking input is experiment.DelayedEpisode(seed=11, index=e) (experiment/delayed.go:70), a counter-based SplitMix64 finalizer over seed + index * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15, so the episode is a pure function of (seed, index); the fixture's starting core weight is placed the same way. The continuous core, the plasticity rule and the chemical kinetics are deterministic and draw no random stream. The exact resume therefore needs the seed and the index, both of which the sidecar cursor plus the fixture constants supply. If a real random source is ever added (dropout, sampled exploration, shuffled data order, a stochastic spiking core), its generator state becomes a new thing to persist and this row has to be verified again; nothing here demonstrates that case. 

(5) Regression for the scalar-pointer bug fixed on 2026-09-19 (commit cf7d792). Before the fix the required-field walk refused every document that set a pointer-to-int rule field, so SaveIndividual could write a receptor-gated individual that LoadIndividual could not read back, which is exactly the resume path this requirement needs. TestLoadIndividualAcceptsScalarPointerRuleFields PASS (0.02s): a two-node individual whose rule sets both GateReceptor and DecayEReceptor to receptor 0 survives SaveIndividual -> LoadIndividual with reflect.DeepEqual equality and both pointers still non-nil; a hand-edited payload that quotes the value ("gate_receptor":"0") is refused with an error whose text contains the field path gate_receptor. TestCheckRequiredFieldsScalarPointerKinds PASS (0.00s) pins the rule itself over *int, *float64, *bool, *string and *[]int: absent and null are accepted, legal zero values (0, -0.5, false, "") are accepted, and the four wrong-kind documents are refused with the exact messages '$.index is not a JSON number', '$.ratio is not a JSON number', '$.flag is not a JSON boolean', '$.label is not a JSON string', plus '$.slice has unsupported pointer element kind slice' for the unsupported pointer-to-slice case. 

(6) The two pre-existing subprocess resume tests still pass unchanged, covering the continuous and the spiking individual without the plastic/chemical layers: TestIndividualCheckpointSubprocessResume PASS (1.08s) and TestLIFIndividualCheckpointSubprocessResume PASS (1.10s), each saving mid-run, resuming in an exec'd process and requiring reflect.DeepEqual against the uninterrupted snapshot and identical output suffixes. TestSubprocessResumeMatchesUninterruptedTraining PASS (1.08s) is the episode-trainer equivalent: 9 episodes split at 4, resumed in a new process, with the restored cursor required to equal 9, the full learning.TrainingSnapshot (which carries the Adam moments) compared by reflect.DeepEqual, and the five-prediction sequence of the restored trainer compared the same way. 

(7) What the two part tests add. TestSaveLoadIndividualCarriesThePlasticPart PASS (0.03s) and TestSaveLoadIndividualCarriesTheChemicalPart PASS (0.04s) show the two optional layers survive the file format itself: an individual that never enabled the layer writes no 'plastic'/'chemical' key, an enabled one writes the declared rule and the chemical keys engineering_kd, node_region, pending_feedback, resources and external_timeline with no null anywhere, the round trip is reflect.DeepEqual-equal, a later caller mutation does not alias a second load, and learning.RestoreIndividual does not change the loaded part.
assumption_statement: 同一台機器、同一二進位、子程序接續（測試 exec 自己的 test binary，不是重新編譯或跨機器）。資料游標由呼叫端以 sidecar 檔案保存：IndividualSnapshot 本身不含 episode 計數，learning/individual.go:97 明文宣告此事，因此「精確接續」是快照加游標兩者一起成立。SetExpressionGain（learning/memory.go:62）宣告的讀出增益未納入此 fixture，快照結構有這個可選欄位但本輪沒有設定它。

limitations: Fixture scale only: three neurons, three edges, one region, one channel, one receptor, eight episodes of a synthetic delayed-pulse stream. Nothing here is a real-connectome, whole-graph or long-run training claim.

Only the continuous core is resumed with the receptor-gated plasticity rule. The LIF path and the DecayEReceptor path are covered for save/load round trip (TestLoadIndividualAcceptsScalarPointerRuleFields) and for a plain subprocess resume (TestLIFIndividualCheckpointSubprocessResume), but no test resumes a spiking individual that has plasticity and chemistry enabled, and no resume test exercises DecayEReceptor.

AdvanceGated (learning/individual.go:408) is not exercised: the fixture only calls Advance, which the implementation documents as AdvanceGated with a zero gate on every row, so the fast weight moves through the chemical receptor gate rather than through a caller-supplied learning gate. A resume across explicitly gated advances is unverified.
No real data and no real training job: episodes come from experiment.DelayedEpisode, and the interruption is a clean SaveIndividual at an operation boundary, not a crash, a kill or a partial write.

No independent random generator exists in this profile, so 'randomness' is verified only in the sense that the data seed and index fully determine the stream. A future stochastic source would need its own persistence and its own verification.
WeightDecay is 0 in the fixture, so the AdamW decoupled-decay term is never non-zero during the resume; only the Adam moments and per-parameter step counts are actually compared across the break.

The chemical layer is compared as part of the whole-snapshot reflect.DeepEqual, but unlike the fast weights there is no assertion that the concentrations are non-zero at the break, so this run does not independently prove the chemical comparison was not a comparison of zeros.
One run, one platform: macOS arm64, go1.26.5, single -count=1 -race execution. No repeat-count stability run, no Ubuntu or Windows run, no cross-CPU bit-identity claim.
